questions.knowledge_point: Identifying the Missing Set to Form a Partition
questions.problem:
Consider the set $X={r,s,t,u,v,w,x,y,z}.$ Which subset must be placed into the blank in the set below so that it represents a partition of $X?$

$$
{{r,t},{x,y,z},\,____\,}
$$
questions.worked_solution:
A partition of a set $X$ is a collection of non-empty subsets of $X$ where every element of $X$ is contained in *exactly* one subset. 

To find the subset that goes in the blank, we must identify which elements of $X$ are not yet contained within any of the given subsets.

Let's go through each element of $X$ and check:

- $r\in {r,t}\,✓$

- $s$ does not belong to any of the given subsets $\,\times $

- $t\in {r,t}\,✓$

- $u$ does not belong to any of the given subsets $\,\times $

- $v$ does not belong to any of the given subsets $\,\times $

- $w$ does not belong to any of the given subsets $\,\times $

- $x\in {x,y,z}\,✓$

- $y\in {x,y,z}\,✓$

- $z\in {x,y,z}\,✓$

The elements $s,u,v,$ and $w$ are not yet contained within any of the given subsets. Therefore, the subset that must go in the blank is ${s,u,v,w}.$
